messages.author: ABDELATIF MESSAOUDI
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users,
I run md simulation with cuda using command production
pmemd,cuda -O -i 05_prod.in -o 05_prod.out -c cpx_04_eq_npt.rst -p SK.top
-r SK.rst -x SK.mdcrd &
this isi the Error :
abdel.abdel:~/+Abdel/SQ$ pmemd.cuda -O -i 05_prod.in -o 05_prod.out -c
cpx_04_eq_npt.rst -p SK.top -r SK.rst -x SK.mdcrd &
[1] 5232
abdel.abdel:~/+Abdel/SQ$ cudaGetDeviceCount failed system has unsupported
display driver / cuda driver combination
best regards
Abdelatif Messaoudi
LCMVAR, University of Batna 1

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Feb 21, 2023, ABDELATIF MESSAOUDI via AMBER wrote:
>
>I run md simulation with cuda using command production
>
>abdel.abdel:~/+Abdel/SQ$ cudaGetDeviceCount failed system has unsupported
>display driver / cuda driver combination
Doing a Google (or other) search on "cudaGetDeviceCount failed system has
unsupported display driver / cuda driver combination" (i.e. the error
message) gives a number of pointers that look promising.
This seems like it might not be an Amber problem, unless you know that cuda
is installed properly.
....dac
